info.title: Koritsu API
info.description: Two entrances, one set of handlers: `/api` for the site (cookie session) and `/api/v1` for external clients (bearer token). Only `/api/v1` is versioned and documented.

post.summary: Register with email and password
post.description: Creates an account and emails a confirmation link. The answer is the same whether or not the address is already taken. 422 validation_failed, 429 rate_limited.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Confirm an email address by token
post.description: Confirms an email address by the token from the letter. No session cookie is issued: the reader signs in afterwards. 400 invalid_token, 400 token_expired.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Sign in and receive a session cookie
post.description: Checks the password and sets the session cookie. 401 invalid_credentials, 403 email_not_confirmed, 429 rate_limited.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Sign out on this device
post.description: Revokes this session and clears the cookie. Needs no authentication and answers alike with or without a live session.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Sign out on every device
post.description: Revokes every session of the signed-in user and clears the cookie. 401 unauthenticated.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: Returns the account behind the session cookie. 401 unauthenticated.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Ask for a password reset link
post.description: Emails a password reset link. The answer is the same whether or not the address is known.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Set a new password by token
post.description: Sets a new password by the token from the letter, revokes every session and confirms the address. 400 invalid_token, 400 token_expired, 422 validation_failed.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.summary: List workspaces the caller belongs to
get.description: Lists the workspaces the caller is a member of, personal one first, each with the caller's own role. `trash=true` lists the ones in the trash instead. 401 unauthorized.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Create a workspace
post.description: Creates a workspace; the caller becomes its owner and its first member. 422 validation_failed.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: Returns the caller's personal workspace, creating it when the account is older than this code. 401 unauthorized.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: One workspace with the caller's own role. A workspace the caller is not a member of answers 404, not 403. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

patch.description: Renames a workspace. Owner only. 400 invalid_id, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 422 validation_failed.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

delete.summary: Move a workspace to the trash
delete.description: Moves a workspace to the trash together with its projects; they stay on the volume until purge_after. Owner only, and the personal workspace cannot be trashed. 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 personal_workspace, 409 in_trash.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Restore a workspace from the trash
post.description: Restores a workspace from the trash. Owner only. 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 not_in_trash.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: Lists the members with their roles and email addresses. Any member may read it. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Add a member by email
post.description: Invites a person by email address. Owner only. 400 unknown_role, 403 forbidden, 404 no_such_user, 409 already_member.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

patch.description: Changes a member's role (owner, editor, viewer). Owner only, and the last owner cannot be demoted. 400 unknown_role, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 last_owner.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

delete.description: Removes a member from the workspace. Owner only, and the last owner cannot be removed. 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 last_owner.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Create a project in a workspace
post.description: Creates a project and its directory on the volume. Multipart: the name and an optional DOCX template; without a template the report is built from scratch. Editor role in the workspace. 400 bad_template, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 project_exists.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: Lists the projects of one workspace; `trash=true` lists the ones in the trash instead. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: One project: name, workspace, the tag keys of its manifest and the size of its directory. Paths are never returned. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found, 409 in_trash.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

patch.description: Renames a project, in the database and in its settings on the volume. Editor role. 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 in_trash, 422 validation_failed.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

delete.summary: Move a project to the trash
delete.description: Moves a project to the trash; its directory stays on the volume until purge_after. Editor role. 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 in_trash.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Restore a project from the trash
post.description: Restores a project from the trash. Editor role. 403 forbidden, 404 not_found.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: Every tag of the template, in the order they appear in the document: key, label, type, whether it is required, and whether it is filled, with the source and the number of the current version when it is. Tags no longer present in the template are left out. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found, 409 in_trash.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.summary: Current tag values of a project
get.description: The current value of every tag of the project, in the shape the report builder reads. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found, 409 in_trash.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

put.summary: Set one tag value by hand
put.description: Writes one tag value as a new version marked source=manual; previous versions are kept. The body is the value itself, a JSON object. Editor role. 400 invalid_value, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 in_trash.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: Lists your live provider keys: provider, last four characters and dates. The key itself is never returned. 401 unauthenticated.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Add a provider key
post.description: Stores a provider key encrypted; a previous key of the same provider is revoked. The response carries the last four characters only. 422 validation_failed.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: Lists the model providers a key can be stored for, and where a key for each would come from: `own` (yours), `shared` (the one the service runs on) or `none` (nothing to pay with). 401 unauthenticated.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

delete.description: Revokes one of your keys. A key that belongs to someone else and a key that never existed answer alike. 404 not_found.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Upload a material into the project
post.description: Accepts a file (multipart field `file`), stores the bytes and queues a `parse` job for them. Answers 202 with the job card and `pending_id`, the identifier the material will have once it is parsed. The same bytes uploaded twice are one material and are parsed once. Editor role. 400 no_file, 402 limit_exhausted, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 413 file_too_large, 413 quota_exceeded, 415 unsupported_type.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: Cards of every parsed material of the project, in upload order. Files still being parsed are in `GET ./materials/pending`. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.summary: Materials accepted but not parsed yet
get.description: Files the project has accepted and whose `parse` job has not finished. Each entry carries the identifier the material will have (`pending_id`), the name it was uploaded under and the job card. An entry leaves this list when the job finishes: on success the material shows up in `GET ./materials`, on failure the job card in `GET /api/jobs` says why. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: The card of one material: kind, size, what its content is numbered by and how much of it, notes of the parser. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

delete.summary: Remove a material from the project
delete.description: Removes the material and the images extracted from it (PDF and Word pages). An extracted image is kept when a tag value of the project still refers to it; the response lists what was removed and what was kept. 400 invalid_id, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.summary: A chunk of the material text
get.description: A chunk of the material text with an anchor a reader can check. Bounds are inclusive and start at 1; bounds outside the material are clamped, and the anchor says what was returned. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: The original file, byte for byte, always as application/octet-stream. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Put a job into the queue
post.description: Accepts a job and answers at once with its card; the work happens in a worker process. Editor role in the project. A second job of the same user waits in the queue instead of being refused. 400 unknown_job_kind, 400 project_required, 402 limit_exhausted, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 in_trash.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: Your own jobs, newest first. Jobs of other people are never listed, not even in a shared project. 400 invalid_id, 400 unknown_job_status.

parameters.name: status

schema.description: Only jobs in this state: queued, running, done, failed, cancelled
schema.title: Status

parameters.description: Only jobs in this state: queued, running, done, failed, cancelled

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: One job of yours: state, progress, result or error. Asking resets the retention clock: a job is kept for as long as it is looked at. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Ask a job to stop
post.description: A waiting job is cancelled at once; a running one is asked to stop between steps, so whatever it has already finished is kept. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found, 409 already_finished.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.summary: Events of a job since a sequence number
get.description: Events of one job in order, starting after `after`. Text pieces are already glued together, roughly every 100 ms. The same rows a server-sent stream reads. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

parameters.name: after

schema.description: Return events with seq greater than this
schema.title: After

parameters.description: Return events with seq greater than this

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.summary: Your monthly limit and what you have spent
get.description: The plan, its monthly cap in internal units, what you have spent since the first of the month and what is left, plus what one job of each kind costs. A job is refused with 402 limit_exhausted once its price no longer fits into what is left.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: Events of one job as `text/event-stream`: `id` is the sequence number, the event name is the event kind, the data is one JSON line. Starts after `after` (or after the `Last-Event-ID` header) and closes itself once the job reaches a final state. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID

schema.description: Sequence number to resume after; wins over `after`
schema.title: Last-Event-Id

parameters.description: Sequence number to resume after; wins over `after`

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: One stream per person: `notification` for anything worth a bell, `job_finished` when a job of yours reaches a final state. `id` is the creation time, which the browser sends back as `Last-Event-ID` on reconnect. There are no emails; this stream and `GET /api/notifications` are the only announcements.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID

schema.description: ISO time to resume after; wins over `after`
schema.title: Last-Event-Id

parameters.description: ISO time to resume after; wins over `after`

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: Your own notifications, newest first, with the unread count. There are no emails: this list and the event stream are the only ways a finished job announces itself.

parameters.name: unread

schema.description: true for unread only, false for read only
schema.title: Unread

parameters.description: true for unread only, false for read only

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Mark one notification read
post.description: Marks one notification of yours as read. Reading twice keeps the first timestamp. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Mark every unread notification read
post.description: Marks all your unread notifications read in one go and answers with how many were marked.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: Every version of one tag, oldest first: who wrote it, in which run, by which model and with which flags. The values themselves are not here; ask for one version. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found, 409 in_trash.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.summary: One version of a tag value
get.description: The header of one version and the value itself, in the shape the report builder reads. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found, 409 in_trash.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Bring back an earlier version of a tag
post.description: Writes the chosen version again as a new one; nothing is deleted, so the answer carries a higher number than asked for. Editor role. 400 invalid_id, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 in_trash.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.summary: Current block list of a project without a template
get.description: The ordered list of named blocks a template-less project is made of. Empty when the project has never had one. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found, 409 in_trash.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: Every version of the block list, oldest first. The list is versioned whole: half the edits move blocks around, and a per-block version answers nothing about that. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found, 409 in_trash.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.summary: One version of the block list
get.description: The header of one version and the blocks it held. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found, 409 in_trash.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Bring back an earlier block list
post.description: Writes the chosen version of the whole list again as a new one. Editor role. 400 invalid_id, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 in_trash.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: Your tokens, newest first: prefix, name, scopes and dates. Revoked ones stay in the list, marked with revoked_at. The token string is never listed. 401 token_not_allowed.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Create an API token
post.description: Issues a token for the /api/v1 entrance and returns its string once: the service keeps only a hash, so a lost token is revoked and reissued, never recovered. 400 unknown_scope, 401 token_not_allowed.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

delete.description: Revokes one of your tokens at once; requests carrying it answer 401 token_revoked from then on. A token that belongs to someone else and one that never existed answer alike. 404 not_found, 401 token_not_allowed.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.summary: List people with plan, quota and spending
get.description: Everyone registered, newest first: plan, storage quota and bytes used, spending in internal units this calendar month. 403 forbidden.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

patch.summary: Change plan, limits or administrator access
patch.description: Changes a person's plan, per-user limit overrides and administrator flag. Fields left out are left alone; limits are replaced as a whole. 404 not_found, 403 forbidden.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: How many jobs wait and run, broken down by kind; the slot limits this machine runs with; and the workers currently holding a job, with the age of their last heartbeat. 403 forbidden.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: Failed logins, account locks, rate limits, refused CSRF and revoked tokens: when, from which address, about whom. Never carries passwords, token strings or email addresses. 403 forbidden.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.summary: Spending, jobs and registrations over the last days
get.description: Spending in internal units per day, jobs of the period broken down by kind with the failed ones counted, registrations per day and how many people ran anything. Days are consecutive UTC days, empty ones included. 403 forbidden.

parameters.name: days

schema.description: How many days back to count
schema.title: Days

parameters.description: How many days back to count

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Payment webhook, not implemented yet
post.description: Reserved for the payment provider. Answers 501 not_implemented and does not read the request body; subscriptions are switched on by the owner in the admin area for now.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Export the files of a project
post.description: Queues an `export` job: the original materials and the artifacts of the project, plus the current tag values and block list, are packed into one zip and stored as a project artifact. Answers 202 with the job card; when the job is done its result carries `artifact`, which `GET /api/projects/{project_id}/artifacts/{artifact_id}` downloads. Editor role. 400 invalid_id, 403 forbidden, 402 limit_exhausted, 404 not_found, 409 in_trash.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: Every module the interface is allowed to show, in sidebar order: id, English title and where its routes live. Modules that are not ready are absent from the list entirely; there is no placeholder for them.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: The bytes of an artifact produced in this project: a drawio XML diagram, a built report, an export. The content type follows the bytes; the answer is always an attachment and is never sniffed by the browser. Viewer role. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.summary: Notices the artifact was built with
get.description: What the builder said while making this artifact: what did not make it into the diagram, what the tracer did not understand. An empty list means there was nothing to say. Viewer role. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.summary: Names of the seven stages, in order
get.description: The stages a piece of work goes through, in order. The interface draws its progress strip from this list, so it is data and not a constant in the client. Values are Russian on purpose: they are shown to a human as they are.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.summary: How far the work in this project has got
get.description: A snapshot of the work: stage states, what it is waiting for, the condition as it was read, problems, and the artifacts of everything already built. Empty `work` means no run has been started for this project yet, which is not an error. Reading it costs nothing: no model call and no stage is run. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

put.summary: Name the material that holds the assignment
put.description: Marks an already parsed material of this project as the condition of the task. Until one is named, a `kadai_run` job refuses: there is nothing to solve. Naming the same material twice is the same state, which is why this is a PUT. Editor role. 400 invalid_id, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.summary: Drawing modes of the flowchart builder
get.description: Every mode the builder accepts, with a short description of what it draws, in Russian for the site to translate. The id goes into the mode field of the two building routes. The GOST mode is listed once, as gost_19_701_90; its former name loopLimit is still accepted in requests.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Draw a flowchart without saving it
post.description: Draws a flowchart from source code and returns the drawio XML without touching the volume: nothing is stored and no project is needed. For the editor screen, where the picture is redrawn while the code is typed. Any signed-in user, at most 30 requests per minute. 400 invalid_source, 400 unknown_lang, 400 unknown_mode, 413 source_too_large, 422 diagram_failed, 429 rate_limited.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Build a flowchart and keep it in the project
post.description: Builds a flowchart from source code or from a text material of the project and stores the drawio XML as a project artifact. The answer carries the artifact id: download it with GET /api/projects/{project_id}/artifacts/{artifact_id} or put it into a diagram tag value. Editor role. 400 invalid_source, 400 unknown_lang, 400 unknown_mode, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 413 source_too_large, 422 diagram_failed.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.summary: Palettes of the UML diagram builder
get.description: Every palette the builder accepts. The name goes into the theme field of the building routes. The css palette paints with CSS variables, so one diagram fits both a dark page and a light report.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Draw a class diagram without saving it
post.description: Draws a UML class diagram from sources in the body and returns the drawio XML without touching the volume. Any signed-in user, at most 30 requests per minute. 400 invalid_source, 400 unknown_lang, 400 unknown_theme, 413 source_too_large, 422 diagram_failed, 429 rate_limited.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Draw an object diagram without saving it
post.description: Draws a UML object diagram from sources in the body and returns the drawio XML without touching the volume. The first source is the entry point, the rest are neighbouring files. Any signed-in user, at most 30 requests per minute. 400 invalid_source, 400 unknown_lang, 400 unknown_theme, 413 source_too_large, 422 diagram_failed, 429 rate_limited.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Build a class diagram and keep it in the project
post.description: Builds a UML class diagram from text materials of the project or from sources in the body and stores the drawio XML as a project artifact. The answer carries the artifact id and the classes that got drawn. Editor role. 400 invalid_source, 400 unknown_lang, 400 unknown_theme, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 413 source_too_large, 422 diagram_failed.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

post.summary: Build an object diagram and keep it in the project
post.description: Builds a UML object diagram from text materials of the project or from sources in the body and stores the drawio XML as a project artifact. The first source is the entry point, the rest are neighbouring files. The answer carries the artifact id, the instances that got drawn and the notes of the tracer. Editor role. 400 invalid_source, 400 unknown_lang, 400 unknown_theme, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 413 source_too_large, 422 diagram_failed.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: Answers while the external entrance is up. Needs no token and discloses nothing about the service.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

delete.description: Moves a project to the trash; its directory stays on the volume until purge_after. Editor role. 403 forbidden, 404 not_found, 409 in_trash.

post.description: A waiting job is cancelled at once; a running one is asked to stop between steps, so whatever it has already finished is kept. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found, 409 already_finished.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.summary: Events of a job since a sequence number
get.description: Events of one job in order, starting after `after`. Text pieces are already glued together, roughly every 100 ms. The same rows a server-sent stream reads. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

parameters.name: after

schema.description: Return events with seq greater than this
schema.title: After

parameters.description: Return events with seq greater than this

get.description: Events of one job as `text/event-stream`: `id` is the sequence number, the event name is the event kind, the data is one JSON line. Starts after `after` (or after the `Last-Event-ID` header) and closes itself once the job reaches a final state. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID

schema.description: Sequence number to resume after; wins over `after`
schema.title: Last-Event-Id

parameters.description: Sequence number to resume after; wins over `after`

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: One stream per person: `notification` for anything worth a bell, `job_finished` when a job of yours reaches a final state. `id` is the creation time, which the browser sends back as `Last-Event-ID` on reconnect. There are no emails; this stream and `GET /api/notifications` are the only announcements.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID

schema.title: Last-Event-Id

post.summary: Export the files of a project
post.description: Queues an `export` job: the original materials and the artifacts of the project, plus the current tag values and block list, are packed into one zip and stored as a project artifact. Answers 202 with the job card; when the job is done its result carries `artifact`, which `GET /api/projects/{project_id}/artifacts/{artifact_id}` downloads. Editor role. 400 invalid_id, 403 forbidden, 402 limit_exhausted, 404 not_found, 409 in_trash.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: Every module the interface is allowed to show, in sidebar order: id, English title and where its routes live. Modules that are not ready are absent from the list entirely; there is no placeholder for them.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.description: The bytes of an artifact produced in this project: a drawio XML diagram, a built report, an export. The content type follows the bytes; the answer is always an attachment and is never sniffed by the browser. Viewer role. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.summary: Notices the artifact was built with
get.description: What the builder said while making this artifact: what did not make it into the diagram, what the tracer did not understand. An empty list means there was nothing to say. Viewer role. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.summary: Names of the seven stages, in order
get.description: The stages a piece of work goes through, in order. The interface draws its progress strip from this list, so it is data and not a constant in the client. Values are Russian on purpose: they are shown to a human as they are.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

get.summary: How far the work in this project has got
get.description: A snapshot of the work: stage states, what it is waiting for, the condition as it was read, problems, and the artifacts of everything already built. Empty `work` means no run has been started for this project yet, which is not an error. Reading it costs nothing: no model call and no stage is run. 400 invalid_id, 404 not_found.

default.description: Any refusal: one shape, machine-readable code

put.summary: Name the material that holds the assignment
put.description: Marks an already parsed material of this project as the condition of the task. Until one is named, a `kadai_run` job refuses: there is nothing to solve. Naming the same material twice is the same state, which is why this is a PUT. Editor role. 400 invalid_id, 403 forbidden, 404 not_found.

get.summary: Drawing modes of the flowchart builder
get.description: Every mode the builder accepts, with a short description of what it draws, in Russian for the site to translate. The id goes into the mode field of the two building routes. The GOST mode is listed once, as gost_19_701_90; its former name loopLimit is still accepted in requests.

post.description: Draws a flowchart from source code and returns the drawio XML without touching the volume: nothing is stored and no project is needed. For the editor screen, where the picture is redrawn while the code is typed. Any signed-in user, at most 30 requests per minute. 400 invalid_source, 400 unknown_lang, 400 unknown_mode, 413 source_too_large, 422 diagram_failed, 429 rate_limited.

get.summary: Palettes of the UML diagram builder

HealthOut.title: HealthOut
HealthOut.description:
Ответ `/health` — единственный маршрут службы, чей отказ не `ErrorOut`.

Исключение намеренное и ровно одно. `/health` отвечает не клиенту, а прокси,
и в обоих случаях — и когда жив, и когда база не отвечает — отдаёт одно и то
же тело: прокси читает не `code`, а статус. Завернуть 503 в форму ошибки
значило бы описать `/health` двумя телами вместо одного, ничего не выиграв.

LoginIn.description:

ModelKeyIn.title: ModelKeyIn
ModelKeyIn.description:
Тело `POST /api/keys`.

Поле называется `key`, а не `secret`: человек несёт сюда то, что у
поставщика называется API key, и переименовывать это по дороге значит
заставлять его гадать, туда ли он вставил.

RegisterIn.title: RegisterIn
RegisterIn.description:
Регистрация. Длина пароля проверяется формой, а не обработчиком: беда
формы уезжает клиенту с адресом поля (`where: body.password`).

RollbackIn.title: RollbackIn
RollbackIn.description:
Тело возврата: номер версии, к которой возвращаемся.

Тело, а не путь, потому что возврат — действие над тегом, а не обращение к
версии: `POST …/values/{key}/versions/{n}` читалось бы как «создать версию
номер n», чего служба не умеет и не должна.

tags.name: v1
tags.description: External entrance for scripts and agents. Takes an API token: `Authorization: Bearer kor_...`, issued at `POST /api/tokens` from the site and shown once. Every token carries scopes (`projects:read`, `projects:write`, `materials:write`, `runs:run`) and is limited to 60 requests per minute. The handlers are the very same ones the site calls; only the way the caller is identified differs, so operation ids here carry a `_v1` suffix. Accounts, provider keys, tokens themselves and the admin area are not reachable with a token.
